source: The runner packaged only tracked HEAD bytes with git archive, checked the SHA-256 of the transferred archive on the server, and embedded that SHA-256 and the 40-character revision as image labels. The OCI verifier checked both labels against the runner-supplied values.
verification: Each retained OCI tar passed blob SHA-256/size, runnable linux/amd64 manifest, attached SPDX SBOM and SLSA provenance subject, source labels, and loaded image ID checks. The installer checked both running container Image IDs and Config.Image digest refs after health; a mismatch fails the deploy job.
limits: Artifacts are retained locally under the revision release directory, not published to a remote registry; the provenance is a BuildKit attestation, not an external signature. QA-08 sustained upload capacity, QA-12 live rollback and overall QA-14 release acceptance remain separate open gates.
